verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Quo serves a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes the platform, and the API docs include a 'Build with AI LLMs' section, so an agent can be pointed at agent-oriented docs. However, the llms.txt entries shown are mostly marketing pages (comparisons, vanity numbers) rather than API reference, and /docs.md and every OpenAPI path tried return 404. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt indexes the API reference, markdown versions of the docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
